subject.title: fix(compact): make /compact command cancelable via abortEmbeddedAgentRun

question: Should maintainers land this PR with the current source-level tests and Mantis Telegram proof, or require another exact-head live gateway diagnostic before merge?
rationale: The code shape is focused and no defect was found, but the change deliberately alters active-run session-state and stop/compact availability behavior, so accepting the current proof versus demanding another live transport run is a maintainer merge-risk choice.

options.title: Land with current lifecycle proof
options.body: Accept the bounded session-state and availability risk because the active-run handle lifecycle, drain guard, source-level negative controls, CI, and Mantis chat proof cover the changed behavior.

options.title: Require a fresh live diagnostic
options.body: Ask for a new exact-head live `/compact` plus `/stop` capture with logs if maintainers want transport-layer evidence beyond the current source-level and Mantis screenshots.

recommendation.title: Land with current lifecycle proof
recommendation.body: Accept the bounded session-state and availability risk because the active-run handle lifecycle, drain guard, source-level negative controls, CI, and Mantis chat proof cover the changed behavior.

likelyOwner.reason: Peter has the strongest recent history across the compact command, queued compaction, and Codex/session-thread surfaces involved in the merge-risk choice.
